nodes: Remove temporary guide component from render output
graph.guide_index_scope: Explicit combined geometry curve indices; coat first and appended Object Info guides second; final guide curves deleted

guide_assignment.metric: 3D Euclidean distance between saved float32 coat surface roots and guide surface roots, arithmetic checked in float64
guide_assignment.coordinate_definition: Both native objects have identity transforms; object coordinates equal scene coordinates. Not geodesic distance or UV distance.
guide_assignment.tie_breaker: Lowest guide id among equal float64 squared distances
guide_assignment.guide_budget_scope: Guide positions and length budgets remain authored from the original 32-member groups, even for empty guides. New membership mean lengths are diagnostic only and never reshape guides.

study_scope: Project-authored compact upright spatial return crowns, only native guide positions changed. Historical guide rest_position staysGN5 with external Restore0. Native coat/mapping/all radii/other layers/scene/official pipeline fixed; evaluated coat positions/radii derived. Not a paper/Houdini reproduction, length constraint or visual match.

guide_change.historical_rest_position: GN5 unchanged; external RestoreFactor0 and unchanged roots do not enforce its historical segment lengths
guide_change.scale: L=order32 uniform Catmull-Rom length of each old savedfloat32 guide,duplicate endpoints; no output arc normalization

control_shape.scope: Saved float32 authored guide controls; best-fit plane RMS=Smin/sqrt(control_count), centered SVD; sampled signed analytic ellipsoid height, not pixel visibility.

authored_shape.scope: Saved float32 authored guide controls; best-fit plane RMS=Smin/sqrt(control_count), centered SVD; sampled signed analytic ellipsoid height, not pixel visibility.

guides.budget_scope: Measured only; not normalized or constrained to control length

evaluated_radius_response.scope: Derived unchanged Profile evaluation on changed spline parameter

arc_length.basis: Uniform Catmull-Rom duplicate endpoints model on float32 controls promotedfloat64; not engine arc
arc_length.constraint_scope: No historical rest arc constraint; Clump internal Preserve Length remains true with its own pre-clump reference

child_center_clouds.scope: 3D child center-position covariance at matching control indices. sqrt(eigenvalues) axes; not tangent-normal cross section, solid volume or image visibility.

height_profile_diagnostic.scope: Signed analytic ellipsoid implicit/gradient height approximation; eight Gauss-Legendre samples per Catmull-Rom segment. Local UC P95 is a geometric envelope, not opaque coverage or pixel occlusion. Arc fractions are averaged per curve.
